label: 1-2 steps after an input e, early in the original phase
explanation: Fires on original-phase (and delimiter) steps right after the letter e was input. It is strongest on the step immediately after e (prev_tok=e: 43% of those steps active, 68% of activation mass), weaker two steps after e (32% of mass), and gone by the third. It only fires early: none at t=0, it peaks at t=3-4, falls off at t>=6, and is never active in the copy phase. The largest activations come from runs of e at the start of the sequence (for example e e e X, where the token after the third e reaches the max). The input token itself barely matters. The predicate holds 95% of activation mass with precision 0.90 and dev F1 0.80, but recall by count is only 0.72: there are many weak activations (bottom quartile, about 4% of mass) at early original-phase steps with no nearby e. It does not fire after e late in the sequence (t>=6) or anywhere in the copy phase.
